decision: bundle: TanStack cookie plugin injected via `cookiesPlugin` + `@excited-live/auth/tanstack-start` subpath
reason: the tokens mount could not be bundled at all: packages/auth imported `better-auth/tanstack-start` at module top level -> @tanstack/react-start-server -> Vite-only virtual modules (#tanstack-start-entry, tanstack-start-manifest:v)
evidence: apps/api/scripts/d1-proof.sh failed at `wrangler dev` with "Could not resolve #tanstack-start-entry"; after the split it PASSes

decision: migrations owner = the Worker's boot-time runner (d1_migrations ledger); CI never runs `wrangler d1 migrations apply`
reason: one writer per ledger, and the runner is already proven on a real D1 binding
evidence: d1-proof.sh: d1_migrations 0001..0003 applied at boot, plan+settings survive a restart

reason: the app reads BETTER_AUTH_* through process.env; without the flag they are invisible and /mcp falls back to dev passthrough (#140)
evidence: wrangler deploy --dry-run lists the vars; local node entry returns 401/401 when the secret is set

decision: deploy target = workers.dev host `excited-live-api-prelive.preamza02.workers.dev`; no custom domain
reason: issue ruling; a two-level `api.prelive.excited.live` is not covered by the universal certificate

decision: workflow order: `wrangler secret put` BEFORE `wrangler deploy`
reason: secret put creates the Worker when missing, so no deployed version ever boots without BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
evidence: probe: secret put on a non-existent Worker created it non-interactively ("Creating new Worker ... Success! Uploaded secret"), probe deleted afterwards

decision: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET generated once (openssl rand -base64 32) and stored only as the repo secret PRELIVE_BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
reason: Worker secrets are write-only; the GitHub secret is the only retrievable copy for #139
the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN has Workers Scripts:Edit (probe deploy 200) but no D1 permission; a new token must not be minted (issue ruling)
evidence: GET /accounts/{id}/d1/database -> 401 code 10000; `wrangler d1 create excited-live-api-prelive` -> "Authentication error [code: 10000]"

decision: smoke gate = 401 on POST /mcp and GET /api/v1/settings after deploy
reason: catches a Worker that boots unconfigured instead of shipping an open /mcp
evidence: verified on the node entry: both 401 with BETTER_AUTH_SECRET set
